speaker: Sheldon
text: You just lied, Penny. But you did it so casually. No rapid breathing, no increase in perspiration. So lack of a physiological response while lying is characteristic of a violent sociopath.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon, are you worried about your safety?

speaker: Sheldon
text: No. I imagine if you were going to kill me, you'd have done it a long time ago.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Leonard. Leonard. Leonard. I need to speak to you.

speaker: Leonard
text: It's two o'clock in the morning. I highly doubt that. Go away. Are you still out there? What?

speaker: Sheldon
text: You're right, it can wait until morning.
